sql: SELECT p.item_id, p.vendor_id, p.vendor_name, v.legal_name, v.name_norm AS legal_name_norm, trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(replace(upper(trim(p.vendor_name)), ' (FICTIONAL)', ''), '[.,''"()]', ''), ' +', ' '), ' ?/[A-Z]{2}/$', ''), '(^| )INCORPORATED( |$)', '$1INC$2'), '(^| )CORPORATION( |$)', '$1CORP$2'), '(^| )COMPANY( |$)', '$1CO$2'), '(^| )LIMITED( |$)', '$1LTD$2')) AS payee_norm FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.payment_run_item p JOIN lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.vendor_id WHERE NOT (trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(replace(upper(trim(p.vendor_name)), ' (FICTIONAL)', ''), '[.,''"()]', ''), ' +', ' '), ' ?/[A-Z]{2}/$', ''), '(^| )INCORPORATED( |$)', '$1INC$2'), '(^| )CORPORATION( |$)', '$1CORP$2'), '(^| )COMPANY( |$)', '$1CO$2'), '(^| )LIMITED( |$)', '$1LTD$2')) <=> v.name_norm) LIMIT 500
